method: Four independent Chrome contexts (one visible camera at a time to share the QA machine GPU; all four simulations/network connections remain live), real local WebSocket relay, keyboard/mouse, touch emulation and gamepad mock. DEV campaign/position/damage fixtures; no physical-device approval.
checks: Four unique participant IDs, four existing kits and three player mirrors in every visitor
Every kit: independent movement, basic attack, Dash, charge hold immobilizes and release starts personal cooldown
Host inventory keeps the authoritative world and visitors running
Shared gained XP, personal resource collection and one class-compatible equipment receipt each, no cross-player pickup
Existing damage path reaches each of four distinct players with personal armor resistance
Three dead allies wait for the last living Xenobinder; no premature boss restart
Collective defeat resets exactly one boss, preserves all classes and revives the group
All four campaign bosses: intro, phase thresholds, existing damage/death and unique personal rewards
Every visitor activates a physical portal; living HP survives travel and a visitor can return the party to base while host is dead
All fourteen campaign areas plus return to base keep four actors/snapshots and personal kits
Four resolutions, guest Gamepad API mock and touch charge captured hold/release without zoom
Visitor reconnect recovers the same seat/class/receipts while the others remain connected
Three collective respawns: stable object/texture counts, no duplicate actors or companions
Host departure pauses every visitor with menu-only return for fixed co-op campaigns
